faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about signup, pricing, security and everyday use.

register.a: Click “Register your clinic”, enter your clinic name, your name and email. Confirm your account and enter onboarding. No credit card required.

setup.a: Onboarding has three steps: clinic details, services and inviting your team. Most clinics start working in about 5 minutes.

import.a: Yes. You can import patients and services from a CSV file in settings. The system walks you through a dry-run preview before saving.

education.a: Not required. The interface is straightforward; the site tour shows the workflow. For questions, email support@dentord.com — we reply the same business day.

free.a: You sign up and use the full Professional plan at no charge through 2026. No credit card required. AI, SMS/WhatsApp and the patient portal are not part of the free period.

card.q: Do I need a credit card?
card.a: No. Registration and use during the free period do not require a card.

billing.a: From Jan 1, 2027 you choose a plan and continue — your data stays. Annual billing from then on includes 2 months free.

cancel.a: Yes. You can close your clinic: first export your data (ZIP), then a short grace period, then permanent deletion. Details are in privacy settings.

security.title: Where it lives and who sees it

storage.a: On EU servers (Supabase EU). Data stays in the EU, closer to you and aligned with regulations.

visibility.q: Who can see my clinic’s data?
visibility.a: Only users in your clinic, according to their roles. Other clinics cannot see your rows — Row Level Security on every record.

backup.a: We run daily backups. You can also export your data (ZIP) from privacy settings whenever you need.

delete.q: How do I delete patient data?
delete.a: GDPR erasure requires clinic owner approval. The flow is in privacy settings — a hard delete from the database once approved.

export.q: Can I export all my data?
export.a: Yes. The owner can download a ZIP export (patients, invoices, document metadata) from privacy settings.

mobile.a: Yes. DentOrd is fully responsive — it works in the browser on phone, tablet and desktop.

users.q: How many users can I add?
users.a: It depends on the plan. Starter up to 3, Professional up to 10, Premium AI up to 20; Enterprise by agreement. During the free period you get Professional limits.

locations.a: Yes, depending on the plan. Professional supports up to 2 locations; higher plans more. During the free period Professional limits apply.

invite.q: How do I invite a doctor or reception?
invite.a: The owner sends an invite by email from user settings. Your colleague sets a password and joins. Plan limits are checked before the invite is sent.

Privacy.title: Privacy / GDPR
Privacy.subtitle: Clinic backup, patient export, and hard-delete requests (owner approval).
Privacy.clinicZipDescription: On-demand owner export: patients, invoices, and document metadata (§8.3).
Privacy.clinicZipHint: ZIP includes patients, invoices (+ lines and payments), and documents/images metadata. It does not include binary files or the full chart (odontogram, treatment plans) — that is the separate per-patient GDPR JSON.
Privacy.clinicZipClosureNote: On account closure (D45): same export → 7-day grace → hard delete (nightly automated job).
Privacy.exportCardDescription: JSON export is available on the patient chart (Export JSON).
Privacy.exportHint: Open a patient → Export JSON. Includes chart, allergies, document meta, appointments, invoices.
Privacy.erasureCardDescription: After approval, patient data and storage objects are permanently deleted (D35).
Privacy.confirmRequest: Request hard delete for this patient? Owner must approve.
Privacy.confirmApprove: Approve PERMANENT deletion? This cannot be undone.
